title: Bowlbug (Rock)
move_pattern: Repeats Headbutt. When off balance (from ImbalancedPower), Headbutt stuns itself. Dizzy is used to wake up and reset the off-balance condition.
notes: This monster is controlled by ImbalancedPower, which periodically sets an 'off-balance' status. When off balance, Headbutt triggers self-stun instead of dealing damage to the opponent. The creature then uses Dizzy to wake up from the stun and reset the off-balance status, returning to the normal Headbutt pattern.
